title: Add Hitstop Freeze-Frames for Heavy Impact Feel
description: Implement hitstop / impact freeze (3-6 frame pause on heavy attacks and counter-hits) to make melee strikes feel meaty and visceral like AAA 2D fighters.

title: Dynamic Camera Zoom and Screen Vignette on Ultimates
description: Add dynamic camera zoom-in and radial screen vignette darkening during cinematic Ultimate activations.

title: Clash Particle Shockwaves on Simultaneous Hitbox Collisions
description: Spawn radial anime shockwaves and high-contrast clash sparks when two attacks collide simultaneously.

title: Implement Kizaru / Borsalino (Light-Speed Fruit Fighter)
description: Author Kizaru (Borsalino) from One Piece with Pika Pika no Mi powers: light-speed kicks, Ama no Murakumo light sword slashes, Yasakani no Magatama mirror barrage, and Yata no Kagami teleport.

title: Implement Broly (Legendary Super Saiyan Brawler)
description: Author Broly from Dragon Ball Super: hulking heavy armor, green wrathful ki aura, Eraser Cannon, Gigantic Roar, armored command grapples, and screen-shattering seismic slams.

title: Implement Rimuru Tempest (Demon Lord Slime)
description: Author Rimuru Tempest from Tensura: Gluttony / Beelzebuth devour vortex, Megiddo water satellite lasers, Dark Flame / Hell Flare orbs, slime shape-shifting dashes, and sword cuts.

title: Roster Recovery & Frame Advantage Audit
description: Audit frame advantage across all fighters so recovery frames allow proper hit confirmation without inescapable infinite strings.
